purpose: BH2 closing boundary: a sourced file (source ./shadow.inc defining set() { :; }) can change runtime command resolution after static analysis. The scanner does not model sourcing/import graphs; it fails conservatively instead - any `source` / `.` statement taints the pipefail and command-resolution state, so a later `set -o pipefail` cannot establish parent-shell pipefail and a masked pipeline goes RED.
accepted_limitation: Dynamic shell code loaded via source/., environment-imported functions, arbitrary runtime-generated shell, and recursive sourcing are NOT established by this static checker. The failure direction is conservative (false red, never false green). Deeper sourcing-graph analysis is out of scope for BH2 and is a BH3 mutation seed.

cases.scenario: sourced file redefines `set` as a function before a plain set -o pipefail call
